title: AIMEM-X1 T1 engineering sample
entry_policy: T1 physical implementation remains on hold until every T0 silicon gate has measured passing evidence.
open_source_boundary: Architecture, RTL, public-PDK proxies, and first-order multiphysics studies may be open source. Qualified 2 nm implementation, memory macros, hybrid-bond process data, and signoff require the restricted foundry lane.
